title: Meteorology-driven Causal Nowcasting of Fugitive Landfill Emissions Enables Proactive Public Health Response
abstract: arXiv:2608.14254v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fugitive emissions from waste sites increasingly expose communities to toxic and odorous gases, yet public-health responses remain largely retrospective, with episodes investigated only after residents have been exposed. Here we show that the meteorological drivers of elevated hydrogen sulphide (HS) at a long-monitored European landfill, and the timescales over which they act, can be identified directly from routine monitoring data. We introduce CAIRN (Causal-Anchored Inference for Receptor Nowcasting), a machine-learning framework whose internal memory is matched to these measured timescales: a fast component tracking hour-scale wind-borne transport and a slow component tracking multi-hour weather changes. Trained to predict gas measurements, CAIRN operates using only routine weather variables and the calendar, without hand-engineered features. translated_title: 气象驱动的垃圾填埋场逸散排放因果即时预报助力公共卫生主动响应
translated_abstract: 废物场所的逸散排放日益使社区暴露于有毒和恶臭气体中，然而公共卫生响应大多仍为回顾性的，只有在居民暴露后才对事件进行调查。在此，我们表明，在一个长期监测的欧洲垃圾填埋场中，硫化氢（HS）升高的气象驱动因素及其作用的时间尺度，可以直接从常规监测数据中识别出来。我们引入了CAIRN（受体即时预报的因果锚定推断），这是一个机器学习框架，其内部记忆与这些测量到的时间尺度相匹配：一个快速组件跟踪小时尺度的风载传输，一个慢速组件跟踪多小时的天气变化。CAIRN训练用于预测气体测量值，仅使用常规气象变量和日历，无需手工设计的特征。其行为与识别的传输机制一致，且该框架可追踪...
tldr: 该论文提出CAIRN框架，利用常规气象数据直接识别垃圾填埋场逸散排放的气象驱动因素，实现主动而非被动的公共卫生响应。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CAIRN, a machine-learning framework that directly identifies meteorological drivers of fugitive landfill emissions from routine data, enabling proactive public health responses.
